ModMetaData.name: Craft Mechtech Chips
ModMetaData.author: Nehr
ModMetaData.description:
Craft Signal chips, Powerfocus chips and Nano structuring chips.
Unlock the ability to craft mechtech chips through research after you've studied the chips. Instead of fighting the same bosses over and over again in order to get mechtech chips this mod gives you the option to also craft them.
This mod can be added to existing saves. Before removing it, back up your save and finish or cancel any active crafting jobs and bills added by this mod.
Now supports the AlphaMechs mod and crafting of Hyper-linkage chips, Stellar processing chips and Quantum matrix chips! (Make sure this mod is loaded after AlphaMechs if you are using both.)
Also adds a research project for Mechlink crafting.
Source code and in-game values at: https://github.com/Nehr/CraftMechtechChips
